Name: The Queen of Sauce's Cookbook - Recipe Tracker
Author: strawhatwem
Description:
[left]The Queen of Sauce Cookbook and Recipe Tracker adds an in-game book through Parchment that allows you to track the recipes you've learned and made. Recipe pages show how it's made and the gift preferences of villagers. 

[list]
[*]Only natively supports [b]Vanilla.[/b] Other mods are welcome to add their recipes to this book (check the Modders section). [/*]
[*][i][b]Your item retextures (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]) will apply, the placements will just look wonky at times....[/b][/i] [/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786120667-45687269.png[/img][/left]
[left]Once you upgrade your house once, Jodi will show up at your door with the book. [/left]
[left][/left]

[left][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121895-61838605.png[/img][/b][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][list]
[*]The recipe tracker is set up as an official "Queen of Sauce Cookbook". There's a foreword by The Queen herself! In reality, this book just allows you to track the recipes you've learned and have yet to learn. [/*]
[*]All bookmarks and chapters (like in the Table of Contents) are clickable! [/*]
[*]Please consult the Guide in the book for more detailed information on book details. [/*]
[/list][/left]
[center][left][/left]
[/center]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121892-883735649.png[/img][/left]
[center][left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121069-1488939616.png[/img][/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121892-1049796562.png[/img][/left]
[/center]
[center][left]When you click on the Misc. category or bookmark, you're taken to this page: [/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121069-1061069349.png[/img][/left]
[left]These categories make up the rest of the vanilla recipes. [/left]
[/center]
[left][/left]
[left][/left]

[center][left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786122633-1432880945.png[/img][/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Each chapter will have pictures of all the recipes in that section. Click on a picture to go to the recipe. You can also flip through the book.[/left]
[/center]
[left][/left]
[left]Some pages will have special little decorations![/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786122593-271002678.gif[/img][/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121993-582679315.png[/img][/left]

[left][b]Unlock Conditions[/b][/left]
[left]Turning this on will show how to get this recipe when you hover over the item's silhouette. Ginger Island recipes will only show this when you have stepped foot on IslandSouth at least once, to avoid spoilers. [/left]
[left][/left]

[left][b]Multiplayer Perfection Tracking[/b][/left]
[left]If you're playing multiplayer, turn this on so recipes track for everybody and not just yourself. [/left]
[left][/left]

[left][b]Emoji Toggle[/b][/left]
[left]There are emojis on each preference page. This works perfect in English, but may not in other languages. Turn this off to remove them. [/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121990-1386632680.png[/img][/left]
[left]If you'd like to add your recipes to this book, you're welcome to do so! Check the articles tab for instructions. [/left]
[left][/left]
[left]Templates are also included in this mod's files, but you are welcome to layout your pages any way you'd like. [/left]
[left][/left]

[left][b]Mods With Cookbook Support:[/b][/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38008?tab=description]Tilly the Tea-Loving Librarian[/url][/left]
[left][/left]

[left][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50155/50155-1786121990-1825560751.png[/img][/left]
[left]Please check the articles tab for translation instructions! This will make your life easier, promise. [/left]
[left]Please ask before translating![/left]
[left][/left]

It is so fun and easy to use. Thank you for taking any questions and requests I've had along the way. [/left]
